verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party pages state that AirDrop makes sharing files between Mac, iPhone, and iPad simple and works even without a Wi-Fi network. Universal Clipboard adds copy-and-paste of images, video, or text between nearby devices, which covers the core story of wireless file transfer between nearby Apple devices. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation (pairing/discovery model, file size or type limits, transfer to non-Apple devices) and independent or hands-on corroboration that AirDrop works as described.
